Beenu Kumar Taneja is an Indian author, entrepreneur, and business consultant based in New Delhi. He is the founder of Taneja Enterprises and has written multiple acclaimed publications on business strategy and digital transformation [1].

Throughout his career, Taneja has advised leading corporations across emerging markets and spoken at international business summits. He has also mentored numerous startups across technology and consulting sectors [2].
